scores.rationale: The candidate implements the basic mechanics of listing sessions over WebSocket outside the per-session lock, but violates many explicit requirements in the ticket. It uses the wrong message types and names (`list_sessions`, `session_list`, `sessions`, `ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionSummaryFrame`) instead of the specified `list_conversations`, `conversation_list`, `conversations`, `ListConversationsMessage`, and `ConversationSummary`. It completely omits the `transport.history?: {enabled: boolean}` opt-in config flag and `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED`, instead enabling the feature unconditionally and returning an empty list (`sessions: []`) when `listFor` is absent—explicitly contradicting the ticket's acceptance criteria. Furthermore, its `limit` validator allows `0` and `> 200` (which the ticket explicitly requires rejecting), it logs raw store error messages (violating the privacy/security requirement), and it fails to update `example/full-config.ts` and `docs/getting-started.md`. Finally, it leaves an untracked `.lore/dod.md` artifact in the repository.
